notes.title: Automatic Watering, Shell Collecting & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]
Our latest update brings brand-new content and useful quality-of-life improvements to make your time on Sugardew Island even more enjoyable. Thanks again for all your feedback – many of these changes were directly inspired by your suggestions!

[h3]✨ New Content[/h3]
✅ Sprinklers – Sprinklers are here to make watering easier and improve late-game farming comfort!
✅ Seashells to discover – You can now find seashells on the beach and sell them for a nice profit.
✅ Keybindings for Mouse & Keyboard – This feature has been available for a few days now, but it’s worth highlighting again: You can now fully customize your controls!

[h3]🔧 Improvements[/h3]
🌤️ The weather forecast is now permanently visible above the radio as an icon, so you can see upcoming weather at a glance.
🔍 You can now switch between three zoom levels to adjust the camera to your preference!

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
🔹 Crash when returning to the main menu has been fixed.
🔹 A bug when reaching max skill level has been resolved.
🔹 Fixed issues with sorting and selection in menus (e.g., Tomte, the workbench, and bulletin board).
🔹 Guestbook and credits scrolling should now work smoothly.
🔹 Tomatoes now behave correctly and produce multiple harvests.
🔹 A rare bug that could cause items to disappear when closing a chest has been fixed.
🔹 Several texts and UI elements have been adjusted.
🔹 Minor visual tweaks and polish added.
🔹 Various smaller bugs and exploits have been fixed.

💬 If you’re enjoying the update or have suggestions for the future, we’d love to hear from you!

📝 And if you’re having a good time on Sugardew Island, we’d truly appreciate a [b]review on Steam[/b]. Why?
Your feedback not only helps us continue improving the game – it also helps other players understand what to expect, especially from a cozy game that intentionally offers a slower, more relaxing pace. Every single review makes a big difference.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy your time on Sugardew Island! 🌿✨

Your rokaplay team 🌿🏡

notes.title: Sugardew Island - Patch News 🛡️v3782
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

It’s been only five days since Sugardew Island launched on March 7, and we’ve already been hard at work making improvements. We are closely listening to your feedback and implementing changes step by step – thank you for your patience and support!

First things first: Keybinding is in progress! 🎮 Many of you have asked for it – we are actively working on it and hope to have it ready soon.

[h3]✨ Key Improvements & Fixes[/h3]
[list]
✅ Achievements from the demo are now automatically unlocked when loading your save in the full version.
🏆 Fixed a bug that prevented the last Steam achievement from being obtained.
🛒 Shop balancing update – We’ve made several adjustments to improve the overall experience.
💎 Dewdrop bonus after selling items – You now receive a bonus when leaving the shop, based on your shopkeeping level.
⚡ Energy warning improved – It now appears earlier but is no longer persistent.
🎵 Many new and adjusted sounds for better atmosphere.
📌 Fixed a UI issue in the shop that could occur when entering with low energy before seeing Tomte’s introduction.
🎮 More controller support – Long sales lists on the stats screen can now be scrolled using a controller.
💬 Speech bubble system fully reworked – They now behave as intended.
🌧️ Rain and other visual effects improved.
📝 Fixed missing text & translation errors.
🔄 Fixed various bugs that could cause softlocks in cutscenes or character interactions.
🐾 Fixed an issue where animal companions were displayed as incorrect pets.
💰 Fixed a bug that allowed purchases at the workbench without having enough dewdrops.
[/list]

[h3]Your feedback matters to us! 💛[/h3]
We know that many players still have additional requests for improvements, and we hear you! This update is just the beginning – we will continue implementing your feedback.

One of the most requested features is Keybinding, and we’re working hard to bring it to the game as soon as possible. Please bear with us – it’s coming soon!

If you’re enjoying the update and having fun with Sugardew Island, it would mean a lot to us if you could leave a review on Steam. Your feedback not only helps us but also assists other players who are considering the game.

💬 Let us know what you think! And if you encounter any bugs, please report them – we’ll make sure to fix them.

Thank you for your support & enjoy your time on Sugardew Island! 🌿✨

Your rokaplay team 🌿🏡

notes.title: Sugardew Island - Patch News 🌿v3747
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, Shopkeepers! 🏡✨[/h3]

We’ve been reading all your feedback from the Alpha Testers and Demo Players, and we’re working hard to improve Sugardew Island! Your thoughts help us make the game cozier and more enjoyable, so here’s what we’ve been polishing in this update:

[h3]🛠️ Changes & Fixes[/h3]
🔹 Key prompts for Strafing (Precision Movement) and Running are now displayed.
🔹 Tree chopping & rock smashing – You can now hold the button instead of pressing it repeatedly! 🌲💥
🔹 Improved seed planting & fertilizing – A visual indicator now makes it clearer that holding the button covers a larger area. The same applies to the upgraded Watering Can & Hoe! 🌱💧
🔹 Some UI elements have been repositioned for a cleaner look.
🔹 Better support for non-16:9 resolutions – No more weird UI placements! 📏✨
🔹 Fixed a bug where pets blocking the Bulletin Board prevented interaction. 🐶📜
🔹 Fixed an issue where NPCs near the Harmony Tree caused interaction problems. 🌳💖
🔹 Island animals should now really, truly, only give seeds once per day. Seriously. For real this time. We hope. 🤞🐑
🔹 Island animals & their current seeds are now correctly saved in the Savegame.
🔹 The fourth owl was stuck in the wrong bush... We freed it! 🦉🎉
🔹 The Quest Progress Bar now behaves like a proper progress bar! 📊✅
🔹 Steam Cloud Saves now work (including Steam Deck & Demo Savegames!) ☁️🎮
🔹 Your character won’t accidentally turn in the opposite direction when letting go of the analog stick.
🔹 The Character Editor preview can now be rotated with the right analog stick. 🎨🌀
🔹 Steam Achievements are now properly saved! 🏆✨
🔹 Some icons have been updated for better clarity. 🎭
🔹 Key mapping for Mouse & Keyboard in the options menu has been corrected. 🖱️🎮
🔹 Fixed a UI bug where cutscenes didn’t properly hide UI elements. 🎬🔧
🔹 Overlong text in some languages has been adjusted for better readability. 📖🌍
🔹 Inventory navigation between your Bag and Storage (e.g., Chest) has been improved! 👜📦
🔹 An unnecessary (and sometimes incorrect) sleep prompt has been removed. 😴❌
🔹 Canceling a charged tool action now works properly with the right mouse button. 🛠️🚫
🔹 Various smaller bug fixes & polish improvements!

✨ Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep those suggestions coming – we love shaping the game with you! 💖

💬 Let us know what you’d love to see next!

Your Team rokaplay 🌿🏡

notes.title: Sugardew Island – Update & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've released a new update for Sugardew Island! 🚀 The demo is now live, and we've already received some early feedback—especially regarding energy management. So we've made some adjustments:

⚡ Energy Changes
✅ Selling items in the shop no longer requires energy
✅ The low energy warning now appears slightly earlier

📌 Gameplay & Balance
[list]
Chilis now drop correctly
Energy bars can now be crafted (2 wheat + 1 carrot)
Energy bars are now cheaper (250 → 125)
Players start with more energy bars (3 → 6)
Watering animation has been shortened
Tool charging time reduced from 1 second to 0.66 seconds per level
[/list]

🔧 Improvements & Bug Fixes
[list]
The negotiation result in the shop can now be correctly dismissed (button)
The counter in the statistics screen now stops correctly
Item sorting at Tomte is no longer inverted
Buying multiple animals no longer causes duplicates
Harmony Tree UI improved (automatic quest selection & better visualization)
Virtual keyboard now opens automatically on Steam Deck
D-Pad control added for item selection
Shortcut for energy bars now assigned to the right analog stick button
The demo watermark no longer overlaps with the logo
Save files now have clear names ("Manual 1," "Manual 2," "Manual 3")
Correct pigs are now unlocked on the proper islands
Lighting & performance improvements
Fixed crashes
Animals should now clip into buildings less frequently
UI now scales better for resolutions other than 16:9
New sounds added & existing ones adjusted
Music updated for certain situations
Fixed issues where multiple buildings appeared interactable at the same time
The "X" button to close the workbench with a mouse is now always visible
Skill descriptions were incomplete in some languages and have been fixed
We’re excited to hear your feedback and hope you enjoy the improvements! ❤️
[/list]

Enjoy your time on Sugardew Island! 🌾

Your rokaplay Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #2: Shopkeeping
notes.content:
[h1]Greeting Shopkeepers!🏡[/h1]

In this diary, we’re diving into one of the most rewarding parts of your cozy adventure—running your very own shop! Whether you’re stocking shelves with fresh produce, helping customers or upgrading your space to make it even better, your shop is at the heart of the island! So, let’s take a closer look at how selling, negotiating, and upgrading all come together to create a satisfying and cozy loop!

[h3]Your Shop: Where the profit happens🏪[/h3]
Your shop is apart of one of the core cozy game loops, all your hard-earned produce can either be crafted into something else, or sold for Sugardew - the main currency of the Island. Sugardew can be traded for seeds, upgrades or little boots and benefits like fertilizer or candy to restore stamina. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/592e43ef2ba07c5c3cefedeae70bdb9922baf2c8.gif[/img]


[h3]Stocking: Watch your shelf!📦➡️🛒[/h3]
Once you place your items on the shelves and open for the day, the island’s forest folk will stop by to shop. They’ll pick out what they want, pay at the till, and sometimes—if they need a little extra convincing—you might have to step in and make the sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/e1d8ef770af003cbf63e75fe18a6723de9f44a31.gif[/img]

[h3]Negotiation: The art of the deal💪💰
[/h3]
Some customers won’t make a purchase right away, and that’s where your persuasion skills come in! You can go all-in for a bigger profit (with the risk of scaring them off) or take a gentler approach with a small discount for a more reliable sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/1281c39a48020ed9e51162f9dabb3099f8702fc0.gif[/img]

[h3]Upgrades: Upgrades people, upgrades!🏗️💖[/h3]
Every sale not only earns you Sugardew but also helps restore Harmony to the island. As you progress, you’ll unlock new tools, bigger shop spaces, and even more plants and creatures to tend to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/86b95aaba0db46440ed4af1fa875a0c8bcd32697.gif[/img]

[h3]Growth: Bigger is better📈🏡
[/h3]
Upgrading your shop comes with plenty of perks. The first expansion allows you to stock more items and introduces handy features like the universal chest. Plus, it makes your shop feel even more inviting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/e12b333c95753e52fa5049561ccbad6421250943.gif[/img]

That’s all for now! Whether you’re carefully curating your stock, mastering the art of negotiation, or growing your business into something truly special, we’re excited to see how you make your shop your own. Let us know your favorite features—and what you’d love to see next!


Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: Sugardew Island – Update & Thank You!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We want to express our heartfelt thanks for all your incredible feedback, it’s truly amazing to see so many of you actively participating! 🎉The first Kickstarter backers have now gained access to the full version, and your feedback has been invaluable in helping us improve the game.

[h3]Our Plan for the Coming Weeks[/h3]
We're working hard on your bug reports and planning to release updates every Friday (subject to change) for beta users. Only one month until release – we're giving it our all! 🚀

[h3]Today's Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
✅ Shop tables: Inventory bag was broken
✅ Item placement (B): Canceling now works correctly for bag, chest, and table
✅ CountPanel: Darker background for better readability
✅ CountPanel: X-Button now properly in the background
✅ RB/LB: Better positioning & improved visibility
✅ Controller & mouse input: Fix for “Feed All” input prompt
✅ Upgrades: Now properly unlock when loading a savegame
✅ Controller navigation: Now works without needing to press a button first
✅ Mailbox popup: No longer opens at incorrect moments
✅ Missing description text for dead plants added
✅ Corrected term for "Place" in inventory
✅ Renamed “Reward” → “Unlocks”
✅ Multiple seeds per day from animals? (Still under testing)
✅ Various text improvements
✅ Handbook bug with controller input fixed
✅ Some sound issues fixed
❓ Intro videos on Steam Deck: Fix implemented, but not yet tested 😉

And that’s just part of the improvements – we’ve fixed even more!

We’ll continue working on Monday, and we’re absolutely loving all your feedback.
Thank you so much for your support – you’re amazing! 💖

Team rokaplay

notes.title: Cozy Quest Highlight: Sugardew Island's New Trailer and Platform Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hello cozy gamers,[/h3]

We’re excited to share some big news with you! Thanks to your feedback and repeated requests, Sugardew Island is expanding to even more platforms, bringing our cozy world to a wider audience.

[h3]Xbox + PS4 Release Announcement[/h3]
You asked for it, and we listened! Sugardew Island will be coming to Xbox (digital release). We can't wait for Xbox players to experience the charm and peaceful vibes of our game.

But that’s not all: Sugardew Island will also be releasing digitally on PS4! Expanding to this platform was a natural next step to ensure even more players can enjoy the cozy adventure.

[h3]Available Platforms[/h3]
Here’s a complete overview of where Sugardew Island will be available:

Nintendo Switch (Digital + Physical)
PlayStation 5 (Digital + Physical)
Xbox One (Digital)
PlayStation 4 (Digital)
Steam/PC (Digital)
[h3]New Trailer Exclusive[/h3]
To celebrate the Xbox announcement, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer featuring never-before-seen scenes from Sugardew Island!

[i]PS: Sorry for the thumbnail 🤓[/i]
[previewyoutube=UXjO9kR0E0Y;full][/previewyoutube]
The trailer is also part of the [b]"Cozy Quest"[/b] Showcase, a cozy gaming event happening right now. This event includes discounts on tons of cozy games, so don’t miss it!

Thank you for being part of the Sugardew Island community. Your support means the world to us, and we’re so excited for what’s ahead.

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: New release date, Nintendo Switch WIP, Gamescom recap
notes.content:
Dear Sugardew Island Community,

We hope you're doing well! We've got some important updates to share with you about the progress of our cozy farm shop adventure. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm—it truly means the world to us!

[h1]Release Date Postponed to 2025
[/h1]
[b]First and foremost, we have decided to postpone the release of Sugardew Island to [u]early 2025[/u]. [/b]

[b]💖 But the reason for this is quite exciting![/b]
we’ve received a grant of €40,000 from the state of Hessen/Germany! This incredible support allows us to implement a highly requested feature that many of you have been asking for. This means that the game will have more content than planned. 

Unfortunately we can't tell you what this feature is at the moment as we are in the process of planning our marketing beats and many showcases want exclusive announcements/features, but we promise you that the wait will have an impact on your relationship with the game 🙃. 

[h1]Nintendo Switch Version in the Works[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce that a dedicated external team is currently working on the Nintendo Switch port of Sugardew Island. This team has already successfully ported several games for us in the past, and we're confident that they will deliver a version of Sugardew Island that will delight all our Switch players. Rest assured, they are committed to maintaining the quality and charm of the game on this platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/4b342dddfba49e88b72194852c9152a6491ca114.jpg[/img]

[i]We switched from Unity 5 to 6 for the Switch port, but unfortunately the shaders broke 😕. But it will be fixed :).[/i]

To place it in perspective: The Nintendo Switch always presents the greatest difficulty, if the Switch version is running, then the port to other consoles is quite "fast".

[h1]Gamescom Recap[/h1]

Two weeks ago, we had the pleasure of attending Gamescom, where we presented Sugardew Island to a select group of German press members and content creators behind closed doors. It was an incredibly exciting experience for us to witness the first reactions to our game, and we can't wait to share more with all of you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/23405806fad99fa57c0290e2b797153ff69badee.jpg[/img]

Our tiny booth in the business area - Other devs showcased also their own games there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/573adfc855946841c73591aec3876663cc0799e4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sugardew Island Poster[/h1]

For Gamescom, we created a special Sugardew Island poster, which was displayed in our booth. We’re curious to know what you think—Would you be interested in getting this poster online 🤔? Let us know in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rokaplay]Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/b3b54793851b6fb8ad770bffb21a5dd21542e02c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Discord Roles[/h1]

[b]Finally, we’re planning to distribute Discord roles by the end of this/next week. [/b]

If you haven’t joined our Discord server yet, now is the perfect time to do so! We’ve gathered your Discord usernames via the Backerkit survey (Kickstarter Backer only), and we’ve set up a bot to automatically assign your role once you’ve completed the survey and joined the server. Don't miss out on connecting with our amazing community!

[url=https://discord.gg/invite/rokaplay]👍 Join our Discord now![/url]

Thank you once again for your incredible support and patience. We’re working hard to make Sugardew Island the best experience possible, and we can’t wait to share more updates with you soon.

Warm regards,

The Sugardew Island Team / rokaplay 👋

notes.title: New Features during Summer!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello dear Sugardew Island community,[/h1]

We hope you're enjoying the summer just as much as we are! 

[quote]A lot has happened in the past weeks and while Discord, Twitter and Kickstarter all received some update news, the Steam community wasn't in the loop - that's entirely on me, so here are the latest infos on the game, let's go! ːsteamhappyː - Lis from rokaplay[/quote]

It's vacation season in Europe, and many of our team members are currently on a well-deserved break. As a result, there are a bit fewer news and updates this month, but after Gamescom we'll continue updating all of you as soon as we got fresh news.

[h2]Guestbook Update 📖[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/d781cfd332d0ae68929b531a628b091f8ef919b6.png[/img]

Our [b]in-game guestbook[/b], which you can find in the shop, is almost complete! We're just waiting on a few more personalized messages from our amazing Kickstarter backers. Currently, there are still some placeholder texts in place. We’re excited to see their personal messages in the game!


[h2]Exclusive Kickstarter Outfit 👗[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/f36461f2ff3060de3ed7822070ea52316217ff01.png[/img]

For all supporters who have been eagerly awaiting the [b]exclusive Kickstarter outfit[/b]: it’s finally fully designed and implemented in the game! We hope you have as much fun wearing it as we did creating it. But don't worry, there are other outfits to choose from as well ;)


[h2]Colorful Animals 🎨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/12e7f1c0f74a0594bff1e67623fe6fe63538320f.png[/img]

Another exciting feature is now also in the game: the [b]various animal colors[/b] are fully integrated. You’ll now be able to discover animals in all sorts of vibrant color combinations on Sugardew Island – the island is truly coming to life with color!


[h2]Work in Progress: Game Intro 🎥[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/54bbba0755794805507ca9502ef1ead34c2778f0.png[/img]

We’re currently working hard on [b]creating a captivating intro for the game[/b]. The texts and illustrations are already finished, and we’ll soon be giving you a first sneak peek. Stay tuned to see more soon!


[h2]New Decorations and Lamps 💡[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/3a12d0955d4181b30e19239492427558a11d55fb.png[/img]

In addition, we’ve completed and implemented new decorations like floor tiles and fences into the game. The island is now even more beautiful and customizable! We’ve also added [b]new lamps that create a wonderful nighttime ambiance[/b]. We’ll be sharing some pictures of these in the coming days – stay excited!

[h2]Early Access 🪅[/h2]

We're also currently working on the **early access version** of the game. It won't be open beta, but some Kickstarter backers will hunt down bugs and test the game, as soon as we get to it. We want to take our time to iron out all the kinks, before the games release. ːsteamhappyː

[h3]Thank you so much for your continued support and understanding during this quieter vacation period. We look forward to bringing you more exciting updates soon![/h3]

Until then, enjoy the summer!

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: Character Editor & New Release Slot
notes.content:
Hello dear Community, 👋

today we're back with an update to give you an insight into the current state of development and some additional information for you. 

[h3]Character Editor 🎨[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/3fe3b3628ba6bd9a7a8ee7e12ee3dc7599815355.png[/img]

The last few weeks we have been working on a Kickstarter stretch goal, the character editor. This feature was very important to many of you and of course to us, so we made sure that this goal was realized first. 🥳

You can design your character completely freely in the character editor and outfits, hairstyles and accessories are not gender locked. You can wear what you want and what you feel comfortable in. 

You will get more information about which other features have been added to the game in the next update! 😊 

[h3]Next Steps & New Release Slot🌻[/h3] 

We are working on the implementation of the other stretch goals. Thanks to your great support and the successful Kickstarter campaign, we were able to unlock some stretch goals, but this also means more work for us in development, which is why everything is taking a little longer than initially expected. 

We will probably not reach the original release date in the 2nd quarter of 2024, which is why the release date is realistically more likely to be in the 3rd quarter of this year. We hope for your understanding, because we want to use the time to provide you with a great game and realize all your well-deserved features. 🥳 

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay
